What a privilege for you to get to put out something that feels so lived-in and thoughtful and real. What a privilege for me to get to read it. Thank you for giving it so much of your time, your attention, your experience, your love. I am grateful, and I think probably better for it. I no longer want to be a famous novelist. I think I will stick to poetry, thanks. Poets are so rarely famous, and almost never in the way other famous people, including novelists, are famous. Hope tour is going well. Thanks so much for this one. I think it’ll be with me for a long time.
